# dsh-highlight-link

让 DSH Web UI 里的链接和 `@` 引用更醒目：统一成一种颜色 `#7b97d9`，链接常驻下划线。
Makes links and `@`-references stand out in
the DSH Web UI: one color (`#7b97d9`) plus a permanent underline on links.
中文 · English
## 中文
### 它做了什么
插件在激活时注入**一张样式表**，卸载时移除。只改两处：
| 目标 | 宿主默认 | 装了本插件后 |

| 正文链接、文件链接、来源链接、抓取到的 URL | `var(--dsw-alias-link)`（蓝），无下划线 | `#7b97d9`，实线下划线 |
| `@` 引用标签（`@文件`、`@会
话`、`@技能`） | `var(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)` | `#7b97d9` |
两处**故意分开设置**，原因是它们根本不是同一个东西：

- **链接**走语义 token `--dsw-alias-link`。改这个 token，所有消费它的组件自动跟着变，不需要逐个组件去点名。
- **`@` 引用标签不是链接的消费者**。宿主用
`--dsw-alias-state-business-primary` 给它们上色，而这个 token 同时被焦点环、`info` 色 tag 等共用。所以插件选择直接选中 `[data-ref-c
hip]`（稳定的业务属性），而不是去覆盖那个公共 token——否则会顺带把焦点环和标签也染成同一个颜色。
插件不碰渲染层以外的任何东西：不发网络请求、没有宿主侧行为、不读写会话数据。
### 环境要求

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`（写在 `engines.dsh` 里）
- 一个跑 Web UI 的 profile（`web`）

从 npm：

装完重启 dsh，或让插件管理器直接应用。卸载：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
也可以在「插件 → 发现」里搜 `highlight` 或 `link`，点一下安装。
### 改颜色
颜色集中在一个常量里，改 `client.js` 即可：
[代码示例省略，未执行]
### 维护上的几个取舍

- 样式选择器用 `[data-ref-chip]` 这个业务属性，**不用**哈希类名 `_refChip_<hash>`——后者每次上游构建都会变。
- `!important` 是**刻意保留*

*的：皮肤类插件会把同一个 token 写成 `<body>` 上的普通内联声明，普通样式表规则压不过内联声明。
- 浅色主题下 `#7b97d9` 对默认浅色底约为 **2.7:1**，是刻意选的柔
和色；深色底上约为 **6.3:1**。如果你更看重浅色下的对比度，把浅色那一档调深即可（同色相 `#4a68b8` 约 4.9:1）。
## English

A small DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that makes links easier to spot in the Web UI:
links and `@`-r

eference chips get one shared color, and links get a permanent
underline instead of the hover-only d

hips get one shared color, and links get a permanent
underline instead of the hover-only dotted one.
### What it does

The plugin injects a single stylesheet at activation and removes it when it is
unloaded. It changes

injects a single stylesheet at activation and removes it when it is
unloaded. It changes two things:
| Target | Host default | With this plugin |
| Markdown body links, file links, source links, fetched URLs | `var(--dsw-alias-link)` (blue), no u

nderline | `#7b97d9`, solid underline |
| `@`-reference chips (`@file`, `@session`, `@skill`) | `var
(--dsw-alias-state-business-primary)` | `#7b97d9` |
The two targets are set separately on purpose:

- Links follow the semantic token `--dsw-alias-link`, so every consumer of that
token follows withou

t targeting individual components.
- `@` chips are **not** link consumers — the host paints them wit

h
`--dsw-alias-state-business-primary`, which is also used by focus rings and
info tags. The plugin

therefore targets `[data-ref-chip]` (a stable business
attribute) instead of overriding that shared

attribute) instead of overriding that shared token.

It also does not touch anything outside the renderer: no network requests, no
host-side behavior, no

host-side behavior, no session data.

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.1-rc.2` (declared as `engines.dsh`)
- A profile that runs the Web UI (`we

### How to change the color
Edit `client.js`; the color lives in one constant:

### Notes on maintainability

- The stylesheet targets `[data-ref-chip]`, a business attribute, not the
hashed `_refChip_<hash>` c

lass name (which changes on every upstream build).
- `!important` is used deliberately: a skin plugi

n may write the same token as
a normal inline declaration on `<body>`, which would otherwise win.
-

The light-theme value `#7b97d9` measures about 2.7:1 against the default light
surface, so it is int

entionally a soft color; on the dark surface it measures
about 6.3:1. Darken the light value if you

need higher contrast there
(`#4a68b8`, same hue, is about 4.9:1).
